blocks.text_bn:
উট চলেছে দলে দলে।
ঊর্মি দেখি সাগর জলে।

উট একটা পশুর নাম।
ঊর্মি মানে ঢেউ।

উ — উট, উৎসব, উপহার
ঊ — ঊর্মি, ঊষা, ঊর্ধ্ব

image_slots.scene_description: উ-এর ছবি: মরুভূমিতে দল বেঁধে চলা কয়েকটি উট — animal spotlight (NCTB p17 composition অনুসরণ), কোনো মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: a small group of camels walking in desert (matches NCTB p17); camels kept in upper two-thirds so stripe lands on sand below, clear of the animals; no people; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A clean children's-textbook illustration of a few camels walking in a line across desert sand, side profile, on a plain white background with a soft dune line. Simple bold outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no other objects. High contrast and clear linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঊ-এর ছবি: সাগরজলে ঊর্মি (ঢেউ) — object/scenery only, কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: scenery-only slot; sea waves (matches NCTB p17); no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of blue sea waves rolling in water, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no boats, no people, no other objects. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: উৎসব — object/scenery only: উৎসবের সাজ (বাঁকা চাঁদ-তারা লণ্ঠন/আলোকসজ্জা), মানুষ ছাড়া; ঈদ/আনন্দ-উৎসবের প্রতীক।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; festive decoration (hanging lanterns/lights, crescent-and-star bunting) symbolising উৎসব; no people, no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of festive hanging lanterns and a string of crescent-and-star decorations, centred, on a plain white background. Cheerful, bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: উপহার — object only: রিবন-বাঁধা একটি উপহারের বাক্স।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only slot; a wrapped gift box with a ribbon; no living being, no stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single wrapped gift box tied with a ribbon and bow, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no other objects, no people. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ঊষা — scenery only: ভোরের ঊষা (সূর্যোদয়), দিগন্তে উঠতে থাকা সূর্য; কোনো প্রাণী/মানুষ নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: scenery-only slot; dawn sunrise over a horizon; no living being, no stripe. ঊষা used strictly as common noun 'dawn'.
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a sunrise at dawn, a soft sun rising over a plain horizon line with a few gentle rays, centred, on a plain white background. Bold clean outlines, soft flat colour, no people, no birds. High contrast so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: বর্ণ-লিখন ট্রেসিং অ্যাসেট — উ ও ঊ, স্ট্রোক-তীরসহ (NCTB মূল)। AI-জেনারেটেড নয়; ভেক্টর অ্যাসেট থেকে অ্যাসেম্বলিতে বসবে।
image_slots.compliance_note: letter-tracing grid for উ and ঊ with stroke-order arrows; vector asset, never AI-generated.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ১২ বর্ণ-শিখি: উ ঊ (🔒 স্থির). Same treatment as পাঠ ১০/১১. Title + letters + পড়ি/লিখি + all NCTB spotlight sentences RETAINED verbatim (উট চলেছে দলে দলে / ঊর্মি দেখি সাগর জলে / উট একটা পশুর নাম / ঊর্মি মানে ঢেউ). No vocab swap needed → action=retain-curated is image/addition-only. Added 'আরও শব্দ' oral strip: উ gets 3 extras (উট, উৎসব, উপহার), ঊ gets 2 (ঊর্মি, ঊষা). Taught inventory at পাঠ ১২ = অ,আ,ই,ঈ,উ,ঊ only (no consonants, no কার): all spotlight/extra words are oral:true named picture-examples → letter-audit EXEMPT; only decodable content = the letters উ/ঊ themselves (b09/b11), NCTB-original → exempt. WORD PROVENANCE (map-first, then web): উ — উট,উৎসব from C1-BAN_word_map_by_letter (উপজেলা skipped: abstract admin term); উপহার memory-sourced. ঊ — map has ONLY ঊর্মি. Confirmed against Bangla Academy আধুনিক অভিধান (baabo.jothartho.com/list/ঊ) + reporting (risingbd): concrete/picture-able ঊ-initial words are near-nonexistent (~50 ঊ words total, overwhelmingly number-words + ঊর্ধ্ব-family + abstracts). Web (sikshalay/jugerpata) surfaced ঊষা (dawn) as the one extra concrete option; added. ঊষা NOTE for reviewer: also a Hindu-mythology proper name (Usha), used here strictly as common noun 'ভোর/dawn' — flag if reviewer wants it dropped. Only TWO clean ঊ words exist (ঊর্মি, ঊষা); no forced third (avoided ঊরু/thigh, ঊর্ণনাভ/spider as obscure/awkward for age 5-6). SPELLING FLAG: NCTB p17 prints 'উর্মি' (উ-initial) but standard/dictionary spelling is 'ঊর্মি' (ঊ-initial); on the ঊ page it MUST be ঊ-initial → used ঊর্মি. Reviewer to confirm (same class of note as অজু/ওযু at পাঠ ১০). Images: উট animal generate_stripe (kept clear of stripe zone, matches NCTB); ঊর্মি sea-waves scenery-only; উৎসব festive-decoration object-only; উপহার gift-box object-only; ঊষা sunrise scenery-only; tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. No cast figures → refs empty. c_codes C-05/C-02/C-06 (imagery only). Ready to merge in order after পাঠ ১১. [UPDATE] ঊর্ধ্ব added to ঊ row per Principal (word-only, no image slot): FLAG — abstract ('upward', not picture-able, unlike all other spotlight words) and carries যুক্তবর্ণ র্ধ (visually complex for a first-vowel page). oral:true → letter-audit exempt; kept image-less by design. Reviewer to confirm suitability.
